The adopted repair proves ultrafilter-to-propositional-compactness directly on the set of all total Boolean valuations and their formula truth sets; it never chooses one realization per finite fragment. reviews.outcome: No serious defect found in the selected nice-name/counting argument. The entry assumes a given externally countable transitive ZFC-model and explicitly computes all name counts inside it. It expands arbitrary-name natural-part replacement, the ground set of codes, a fallback-defined ground surjection and the name for its evaluation graph. Exact Cohen continuum assumes the ground countable-power identity; CH-to-aleph-two arithmetic is proved separately. No unconditional model-existence or syntactic ConZFC implication is newly asserted.
